posts.title: The day so far
posts.text: At least 68 people have been killed and dozens more injured after two passenger trains collided in Toledro province in central Spain. The Health Department of Castilla-La Mancha has reduced the number of people in hospitals in the region to 53, after 56 were discharged, El Pais reported.

The CSIF civil servants’ union has called for the resignation of Transport Minister Óscar Puente following Wednesday’s train accident. “The minister is shamefully using a worker as a scapegoat instead of taking responsibility,” the union said, adding: “The minister has evaded all responsibility despite the initial…
Spain’s Civil Guard said one of its officers, Jose Manuel, died in the train crash. The national law enforcement agency expressed its “deepest condolences” to his family, friends and colleagues.
The number of people in hospital has risen to 107, The Emergency Services of Castilla-La Mancha said.

The president of the Andalusian Regional Government, Juanma Moreno, has demanded the central government conducts a “ complete review of the railway lines “ in Andalusia and in particular the high-speed line connecting the region with Madrid. “The AVE high-speed train that links Madrid and Andalusia is no longer a safe…

A total of 36 people who were traveling on the trains involved in the Toledo train crash received medical attention at Atocha station, El Pais reported. At the same location, around 40 relatives of those affected by the accident also received mental health support.

The death toll remains at 68 as rescue teams work to remove the two worst-damaged carriages of the Iryo train. But sources at the Advanced Command Post told El Pais they expected more bodies will be found. Three large cranes are currently working on the rescue operation.

Ana San Emeterio Freire told El Mundo she has no information about her brother, José Ángel, 54, who went to the station to assist with the search. She said: “Why don’t they fix the tracks?”, adding she had planned to go to Madrid. “I’m going to cancel my ticket right now.”
